15.item: quia non licet praegnantes poenae repraesentari
15.sense_relied_on: the pregnant may not be put to punishment
one of the attending officers, left visible for the critic

15.item: Modo ego patior quod patior; illic alius erit in me qui patietur pro me
15.sense_relied_on: now I suffer what I suffer; there Another in me shall suffer for me
